statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction legislates guaranteed public access to frontier AI, or an AI dividend or sovereign fund paid to citizens (Official gazette; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2023. No top-3 compute jurisdiction legislated public access to frontier AI or an AI dividend. The nearest Bloc A step was a bill (introduced, not enacted) to establish a national AI research resource for researchers; the Bloc A executive order of Oct 2023 is an executive act, not legislation, and does not create citizen access or a dividend.

items.summary: A bill was introduced in a Bloc A legislature to establish a national AI research resource (shared compute and data for researchers); in 2023 it remained at 'Introduced' status. Researcher access, not guaranteed public access or a dividend.
items.detail: H.R.5077, CREATE AI Act of 2023 (118th Congress), introduced 2023-07-28 by Rep. Anna Eshoo, referred to House Science, Space, and Technology (verified via web_extract this run on congress.gov; later 2024 committee action ignored under as-of rule).

items.summary: Bloc A's head of government signed a broad AI executive order on safety, security and trustworthy AI; it is an executive act, not legislation, and contains no AI dividend or guaranteed public-access entitlement.
items.detail: Bloc A Executive Order 14110, 'Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence', signed 2023-10-30, published 88 FR 75191 on 2023-11-01 (verified via web_extract this run; only head/tail of text extracted, so absence of a dividend provision is our reading of the order's scope, confidence med).
